badges.description: Tucked in the Sleeping Feather Dragon masterfully.

quests.title: 🛏️ Tuck in the Sleeping Feather Dragon
quests.description: Make your bed beautifully! Fluff pillows and pull up the sheets.

quests.title: 📜 Study the Magic Wizard Scrolls
quests.description: Read your favorite book or practice schoolwork for 30 peaceful minutes.

quests.title: 🧼 Wash the Royal Crystal Chalices
quests.description: Wash dishes after dinner or fully load/unload the magic dishwashing machine.

quests.title: 🧺 Fold the Enchanted Pixie Cloaks
quests.description: Sort, fold, and beautifully put away your clean garments in drawers.

quests.title: 🧹 Sweep the Pixie Dust from the Chamber
quests.description: Clean up all toys from the chamber floor, dust surfaces, and align objects.

quests.title: 🌳 Tidy the Enchanted Garden Paths
quests.description: Rake scattered leaves, clear weed invaders, or sweep the pathways outside.

rewards.title: 🎮 30 Minutes iPad Screen Time
rewards.description: Unlock the magical digital scrolls for games or animated shows.

rewards.title: 🍦 Legendary Frozen Treats Quest
rewards.description: Embark on an expedition to the local parlor/freezer for gourmet ice cream.

rewards.title: 🍿 Family Cinema Commander
rewards.description: Choose the film we watch for family movie night and secure the optimal seat.

rewards.title: 🌙 Midnight Scroll (Sleep 30mins late)
rewards.description: Earn the right to extend your evening bedtime by 30 extra minutes.

rewards.title: 🎲 Board Game Captain
rewards.description: Choose and captain any parlor game during the family board game meetup.

notes.text: 👋 Welcome to the Family Skylight Board! Work as a team to complete quests and level up! Parents, turn on Parental Controls (Default PIN: 1234) at the top right to customize tasks or approve rewards.
notes.author: Grandmaster Parent

notes.text: Remember: Sunday is chore approval audit. Quests pending approval will be reviewed for extra XP bonuses! Good luck helpers! 🏆
notes.author: Commander Mom
